meta.title: Code passes initial check, but fails on closure-dyn type check after any operation
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-02-17 and 2025-02-24; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-02-24. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Unsizing Arc<Mutex<{closure}>> to Arc<Mutex<dyn FnMut(i32) -> i32>> needs the struct fields to be known to the trait solver (chalk); they were passed lazily, so the coercion succeeded or failed depending on what had been computed before, and a re-check after an edit reported E0308.

settings_note: The reported E0308 has no quick fix, and rust-analyzer marks a type mismatch without fixes as experimental (type_mismatch.rs: diag.experimental = true when there are no fixes), shown only with rust-analyzer.diagnostics.experimental.enable (default false); the reporter saw it, so it was on in his editor, and the case turns it on for every session. The reporter's rustc_wrapper (sccache) plays no role: checkOnSave stays off, so only the native diagnostics are compared.

files.source: issue body, 'code snippet to reproduce' block

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: As screened (R1 edit-undo), following the issue's steps: open src/main.rs (the initial check passes), make a minor change (insert a space at the start of line 5) and undo it (delete the space), then request the file's diagnostics (textDocument/diagnostic). Reported: after any edit the server reports E0308 'expected Arc<Mutex<dyn FnMut(i32) -> i32>>, found Arc<Mutex<{closure}>>', which a restart clears. Probe: the diagnostics after the edits are compared with a fresh session on the same text (a restart) and a fresh control.

attempts.summary: Run 2026-09-23T09:45 (this case revision): not-reproduced-pre. Every session on both builds, the case session after the space edit and undo as well as the fresh and control sessions, reported the E0308 'expected Arc<Mutex<dyn FnMut(i32) -> i32>, Global>, found Arc<Mutex<{closure#1}>, Global>' (3/3 each), so the answers were equal on the pre build and the post build 2025-02-24 (which contains #19122) also reports it. In this harness the error does not depend on the edit history (the first diagnostics of a fresh session already have it, as in rust-analyzer-21173), and #19122 does not remove it with the local std (rustc 1.98.1, seven months newer than the reporter's 1.84); a commenter later wrote that the problem was also fixed in the new trait solver (2025-09). No release pair isolates the reported behavior here; no second attempt.
attempts.verdict: not-reproduced-pre (E0308 on fresh sessions of both builds)
